description: Load Axiom's documented routing gate at Claude Code session start, and print Axiom's static statement when a prompt arrives.

hooks.command: printf '%s\n\n' 'You have Axiom in Claude Code. Load this startup front door before deciding whether any Axiom skill applies:'; cat "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/skills/using-axiom/SKILL.md"

printf '%s\n' 'Axiom: material ambiguity that context cannot resolve is clarified before acting; completion rests on evidence observed in this session, names what remains unresolved, and replies in the language of the request.'
